correctness.rationale: The exact block decomposition of the p-distance quadratic form is independently re-expanded, with all zero-sum coefficients and arbitrary part profiles. The finite symmetric compression gives a necessary and sufficient bound; spectral maximization gives the secular root and multiplicity; Schoenberg Gram rank proves affine dimension. The rational K_{4,2,2,2} witness is 3/8, while all two-part maxima are at most 5/8. A direct standard-library checker completed 315 exact generic tests and the critical identities, supplementary rather than substitutes for the proof.
